description: This Java class, LoanAccountDataV1Enricher, implements the DataEnricher interface to enrich LoanAccountDataV1 objects with additional data obtained from an external repository. It adds external owner IDs, settlement date, purchase price ratio, and updates charges with external owner IDs.

classes.name: LoanAccountDataV1Enricher
classes.description: A component that enriches LoanAccountDataV1 objects by fetching and adding additional related data such as external owner IDs and settlement dates from the ExternalAssetOwnerTransferRepository.

methods.name: isDataTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if the provided class type is supported for enrichment, specifically if it is assignable from LoanAccountDataV1.

methods.name: enrich
methods.description: Enrichs the LoanAccountDataV1 object by retrieving active transfers for the loan ID, then populating external owner ID, settlement date, purchase price ratio, and updating charges accordingly.
